requirements.requirement: The system must define a structured triage data contract containing recruiting_status, condition_match, pass_flag, and explanation_text fields.
The system must enforce recruiting_status as an enumerated value consistent with backend output (e.g., recruiting, not_recruiting, unknown).
The system must represent condition_match as a boolean indicating whether the trial matches the user condition.
The system must represent pass_flag as a boolean indicating overall triage pass or fail status.
The system must include explanation_text as a human-readable string explaining the triage decision.
The system must ensure the data contract is compatible with MessageBubble rendering inputs without requiring transformation.
The system must align field names and types with backend EVAL-CT-TRIAGE output schema.
The system must support serialization of the triage contract in JSON format for frontend-backend communication.
The system must define all fields as required except explanation_text, which may be nullable.
The system must provide a default fallback value of 'unknown' for recruiting_status if missing from backend response.
The system must provide a default explanation_text of 'No explanation available' when explanation_text is null or empty.
The system must validate incoming triage data against the defined contract schema before rendering.
The system must reject and log triage data that fails schema validation.
The system must ensure the contract supports ordering of fields such that recruiting_status and condition_match can be displayed before pass_flag and explanation_text.
